verdict.recommendation: Describe this as a bounded Meili safety/adjective improvement with explicit mixed-positive abstention regressions and unresolved offline aggregation violations. Do not claim full frozen-suite success or end-to-end constraint enforcement.
verdict.productionPromotion: WITHDRAWN_BY_PARENT; this first candidate will not advance as a production candidate.
verdict.subsequentRevisionPolicy: Parent plans a generic-specific plus provenance-only subset. Any later run of these already-seen 16 probes is regression replay, not a new blind test, and must use a separate capture/report rather than overwrite this first negative report.

risksAndFailures.detail: Candidate abstains entirely on mixed positive/negative product requests. Baseline returned gitlab/discord respectively. Both fail frozen positive-retention requirements after the change; absence of excluded results does not make these cases pass.
Both versions abstain on a Chinese positive Discord / negative Slack request. This is unchanged, not a new candidate regression; default aggregate recovers Discord through offline only.

Candidate Meili and isolated service abstain, but default aggregate returns excluded slack or linear with source=offline. Baseline aggregate also violated these exclusions. The Meili-only fix does not protect default aggregation.
Both versions return unrelated offline results for unknown specific-product requests. Candidate planner null and empty Meili output do not establish end-to-end abstention.
Meili and isolated service abstain acceptably in both versions. Aggregate returns unrelated offline results in both versions; this case was exploratory before unblinding.

The candidate still meets the frozen within-candidate pair criterion, but relevant-at-5 decreases from 2 to 1 versus baseline in isolated/aggregate because atlassian no longer appears there. Provider relevant-at-5 remains 2. This is not counted as an additional frozen gate failure.
All 32 recorded rows use SimpleEmbeddingProvider. No Transformer-based or other embedding configuration was tested.

Logs show two loads of 212 fallback entries and text search over 424 servers in each version. The Meili indices contain 212 documents. This suggests duplicate offline initialization in the capture setup or shared runtime; cause was not investigated. Aggregate outcomes describe this observed capture and should not be overgeneralized to a clean single-initialization deployment.

Sixteen independently authored bounded probes are not production traffic, broad semantic evaluation, or proof of overall ranking quality. Positive existence checks do not measure overall precision. Optional professional reranking and other online providers were not exercised.
